# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user. 

# Variant calls preparation

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(viridis)
```

## Read in data 

```{r}
# CNV and SNV
variant_combined_full <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/SNV_CNV_combined_full_withmeta.csv")

mut_list_full <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/SNV_CNV_mutlist.rds")
```


## 1. Genomic-like subtype defintion 

```{r}
# Create heatmap combining information from mutations and IHC scores
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

save_sum <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

# Save sum_matrix 
#write_csv(save_sum, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/mutation_per_PID_binary.csv")
```

### Manual annotation 

```{r}
# Create heatmap combining information from mutations and IHC scores
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Select mutations of interest
driver_mat <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% select(VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

# Add IHC scores
driver_mat$BAP1_IHC <- variant_combined_full$BAP1_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
driver_mat$PBRM1_IHC <- variant_combined_full$PBRM1_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
driver_mat$H3K36me_IHC <- variant_combined_full$H3K36me_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]

# Create two heatmaps for mutations and IHC scores
mut_mat <- driver_mat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN) 
IHC_mat <- driver_mat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(BAP1_IHC, PBRM1_IHC, H3K36me_IHC)

## Define colors
mut_col <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("lightgrey","#A6CEE3","#1F78B4"))

## Create heatmap
ht_mut <- Heatmap(t(mut_mat), col = mut_col)%v%
  Heatmap(t(IHC_mat), col = viridis(100), na_col = "grey", cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE)

ht_mut <- draw(ht_mut)

# Extract column order for manual annotation of genomic subtypes
col_order_ht <- column_order(ht_mut)
driver_mat_ordered <- driver_mat[col_order_ht,]

#write_csv(driver_mat_ordered, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/genomic_subtype_anno_new.csv")
```

### Visualization

```{r}
# Depends on previous code chunk 
# Read in after manual genomic subtype annotation based on TracerX criteria
driver_mat_anno_out <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/genomic_subtype_anno_new.csv")

# Annotate original dataframe
driver_mat_anno <- driver_mat
driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype <- driver_mat_anno_out$genomic_subtype[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, driver_mat_anno_out$PID)]

# define evolutionary subtypes ("like")
driver_mat_anno <- driver_mat_anno %>% mutate(evolution_type = ifelse(genomic_subtype %in% c("multiple_drivers", "BAP1_driven", "VHL_wildtype"), "punctuated_like", ifelse(genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "branched_like", "linear_like")))

driver_mat_anno$evolution_type_comb <- ifelse(driver_mat_anno$evolution_type == "punctuated_like", "punctuated_like", "branched_linear_like")

driver_mat_anno$evolution_type_comb_1 <- ifelse(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype %in% c("multiple_drivers", "BAP1_driven"), "high_risk", ifelse(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "low_risk", "medium_risk"))

# match
driver_mat_anno <- driver_mat_anno[match(rownames(mut_mat), driver_mat_anno$PID),]


# Column Annotation
## Define colors 
library(wesanderson)
subtype_col <- setNames(c("#046C9A", "#000000", "#D69C4E", "#ECCBAE", "#ABDDDE"),sort(unique(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype)))
evo_col <- setNames(wes_palette("Moonrise3", 5)[1:3],c("punctuated_like","linear_like", "branched_like"))

ca <- columnAnnotation(genomic_subtype = driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype, 
                       evolution_type = driver_mat_anno$evolution_type, 
                       col = list(genomic_subtype = subtype_col, evolution_type = evo_col))

# Select Genes for display
#mut_mat <- mut_mat %>% select(-PIK3CA)

# Create heatmap 
ht_mut_anno <- Heatmap(t(mut_mat), name = "Mutation status", 
                       col = mut_col, 
                       column_split = driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype, 
                       column_title = "Genomic subtypes", 
                       cluster_column_slices = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE)%v%
  Heatmap(t(IHC_mat), name = "IHC score",
          col = viridis(100), 
          na_col = "grey", 
          cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE)%v%ca

ht_mut_anno <- draw(ht_mut_anno)
```

```{r}
# Save object 
write_csv(driver_mat_anno, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/genomic_subtype_anno_final.csv")
```

### Survival testing 

```{r}
driver_mat_anno$OS_months <- variant_combined_full$OS_months[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
driver_mat_anno$status_OS <- variant_combined_full$status_OS[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
```

```{r}
#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ genomic_subtype, data = driver_mat_anno)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme¨
          palette = c("#046C9A", "#000000", "#D69C4E", "#ECCBAE", "#ABDDDE"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)


fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ evolution_type, data = driver_mat_anno)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = rev(wes_palette("Moonrise3", 5)[1:3]),
          conf.int = FALSE
)

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ evolution_type_comb, data = driver_mat_anno)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ evolution_type_comb_1, data = driver_mat_anno)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```

### Across progression

#### Genomic subtypes 

```{r}
# Binary genomic subtype matrix 
genome_matrix <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype, driver_mat_anno$PID))

  
# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each category
  perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","PDL1_score","necrose"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  #i = "ISUP_combined"
  if(i %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  }else{
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "3/4",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1/2",]$PID)
  }  
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(genome_matrix, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }



isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# Visualize findings 

## Waterfall plot with ggplot
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x = reorder(gene, -p_out), y = p_out, fill = odds_ratio > 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~category)+
  geom_segment(aes(xend = gene, y = 0, yend = p_out), color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = ifelse(fisher_full$p_out > -log10(0.1) & fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1, "#E41A1C",
                                                                  ifelse(fisher_full$p_out < log10(0.1) & fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1, "#377EB8", "grey")))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  labs(x = "Genomic subtypes", y = "(-)log10(P-Value)")

## Dotplot with ggnewscale
library(ggnewscale)

# P-values at 0.1 
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))

ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=reorder(gene, -p_out), y = category,col = odds_ratio, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_value), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Genomic subtype")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
                            
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=reorder(gene, -p_out), y = category,col = odds_ratio, size= -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Genomic subtype")
```

### IHC scores and mutations 

```{r}
IHC_mut <- driver_mat_anno[,1:9]

# Give subclonal mutations a score of 1
IHC_mut[,2:6][IHC_mut[,2:6] == 0.5] <- 1

# Give expression a score of 1 if > 0
#IHC_mut[,6:8][IHC_mut[,6:8] > 0] <- 1

## PBRM1
PBRM1_viz <- IHC_mut %>% select(PID, PBRM1, PBRM1_IHC) %>% unique() %>% mutate_all(as.character) %>% group_by(PBRM1, PBRM1_IHC) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(!is.na(PBRM1_IHC)) %>% group_by(PBRM1) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))

ggplot(PBRM1_viz, aes(x = PBRM1, y = fra, fill = PBRM1_IHC))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste0("Fisher = ", fisher.test(xtabs(n ~ PBRM1 + PBRM1_IHC, data = PBRM1_viz))$p.value))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

## BAP1
BAP1_viz <- IHC_mut %>% select(PID, BAP1, BAP1_IHC) %>% unique() %>% mutate_all(as.character) %>% group_by(BAP1, BAP1_IHC) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(!is.na(BAP1_IHC)) %>% group_by(BAP1) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))

ggplot(BAP1_viz, aes(x = BAP1, y = fra, fill = BAP1_IHC))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste0("Fisher = ", fisher.test(xtabs(n ~ BAP1 + BAP1_IHC, data = BAP1_viz))$p.value))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

## SETD2
SETD2_viz <- IHC_mut %>% select(PID, SETD2, H3K36me_IHC) %>% unique() %>% mutate_all(as.character) %>% group_by(SETD2, H3K36me_IHC) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(!is.na(H3K36me_IHC)) %>% group_by(SETD2) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))

ggplot(SETD2_viz, aes(x = SETD2, y = fra, fill = H3K36me_IHC))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste0("Fisher = ", fisher.test(xtabs(n ~ SETD2 + H3K36me_IHC, data = SETD2_viz))$p.value))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")
```
